title: 12 Euro 💚
caption: Folge 1: Er hatte nur 12 € – und gab trotzdem alles zurück. 🥝💸 Kommentiere für Teil 2!

scenes.p: a small kiwi fruit character (the whole body is a fuzzy brown kiwi with big cartoon eyes), worn-out beige t-shirt with stains, small old backpack, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, pushing a rusty old bicycle past a huge modern villa with palm trees and sports cars, golden hour, he looks down at a black leather wallet on the sidewalk

lines.t: Auf Kalles Anzeige standen zwölf Euro. Mehr hatte er nicht.
Und dann lag da diese Geldbörse. Prall gefüllt.

scenes.p: a small kiwi fruit character (the whole body is a fuzzy brown kiwi with big cartoon eyes), worn-out beige t-shirt with stains, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, holding up a black wallet to a golden pineapple character (the whole body is a shiny pineapple with green crown leaves and calm cartoon eyes), elegant black shirt, gold watch, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, in front of a villa gate, sunset

lines.t: Da sind über tausend Euro drin. Und du gibst sie einfach zurück?

scenes.p: a round watermelon character (the whole body is a green striped watermelon with cartoon eyes and a smug grin), brown leather jacket, white sneakers, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, leaning on a black car in front of a red brick school, laughing and pointing at a small kiwi fruit character (the whole body is a fuzzy brown kiwi with big cartoon eyes), worn-out beige t-shirt with stains, old bicycle, looking sad

lines.t: Siehst du die Zahl, Kalle? Fünfzigtausend. Und du? Zwölf!
Mit dem Rad kommst du nicht mal bis zum Bäcker.

scenes.p: school classroom, a small kiwi fruit character (the whole body is a fuzzy brown kiwi with big cartoon eyes), worn-out beige t-shirt with stains, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, sitting at a wooden desk with an open old lunch box with one dry slice of bread, behind him a round watermelon character (the whole body is a green striped watermelon with cartoon eyes and a smug grin), brown leather jacket, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, biting into a huge sandwich

lines.t: In der Pause gab es für Kalle wieder nur trockenes Brot.
Egal. Irgendwann repariere ich nicht nur Fahrräder. Irgendwann hab ich eine eigene Werkstatt.

scenes.p: luxurious dining room with crystal chandelier and marble table, a golden pineapple character (the whole body is a shiny pineapple with green crown leaves and calm cartoon eyes), elegant black shirt, gold watch, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, gently putting a hand on the shoulder of a small kiwi fruit character (the whole body is a fuzzy brown kiwi with big cartoon eyes), worn-out beige t-shirt with stains, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, with a tear, warm plate of food in front of him

lines.t: Iss ruhig, Kalle. Ehrlichkeit wie deine sieht man selten.
So ein Essen hatte ich noch nie.

scenes.p: close-up of a golden pineapple character (the whole body is a shiny pineapple with green crown leaves and calm cartoon eyes), elegant black shirt, black headband with a small blank glowing green panel on the forehead, mysterious smile, holding an old faded photo face down, dim warm light

lines.t: Morgen zeige ich dir etwas, das niemand über diese Anzeigen weiß.
Kalle ahnte nicht, dass dieses Foto alles verändern würde.
